sources.title: The CEO of CoreWeave explains why they went public—and why they scaled back their initial offer
sources.quote_checked: Going public was a means to an end for us. | it just made sense to shrink the size of the offering | When the hyperscalers built a function for CPU computing, they built a minivan | We have a better software solution to optimize the infrastructure. | we'll be able to borrow at a much tighter spread | the debt markets are how we will finance and build the business and scale it

sources.title: CoreWeave CEO defends AI "circular" deals as "working together"
sources.quote_checked: Companies are trying to address a violent change in supply and demand. | You do that by working together. | I think people are myopic a lot of times. | I couldn't be prouder of what the company has accomplished.

sources.title: What is CoreWeave, the AI startup that just saw its valuation increase to $19 billion?
sources.quote_checked: I would argue that no one understood it. | Everybody was caught on their back foot. | We built a highly performant solution. | a very specialized use case in the cloud | the largest supercomputers on the planet | we're building them again and again and again | an incredibly pure, distilled moment of people's investment in AI

sources.title: CoreWeave CEO calls Oracle a "formidable competitor"
sources.quote_checked: Oracle has its own set of products that they're offering, and they are a formidable competitor. | what's going to differentiate us from anyone else is the ... software stack | trying to incorporate any legacy technology | incorporate any history of success or failure | The market's going to take some time to understand the extent of our business.

sources.title: The Year AI Gets to Work
sources.quote_checked: That is why production, not possibility, will be the defining challenge in the year ahead. | works to build more than 5 gigawatts of AI factories by 2030 | The Essential Cloud for AI | AI succeeds when complementary software, infrastructure, and operations are designed together.
